organizations.nameVariants: Roehr; Roehr, A. G.; Verlag Roehr
organizations.publicNote: Berlin music publisher documented as Roehr A.-G. and Verlag Roehr. It is distinct from the short-lived C. M. Roehr Musikverlag GmbH established separately by Curt Max Roehr in 1927. No matching formal GND or VIAF corporate authority has been identified.
